subject: Civil Engineering
title: Feasibility Studies
description: A quick, practical guide to Feasibility Studies.

hook.text: Before spending billions, someone must ask — is this project even possible and worth doing?

buildup.text: Feasibility studies evaluate technical, financial, environmental, and legal viability.

discovery.text: Cost-benefit analysis compares total project cost against expected returns over its lifetime.

twist.text: Many mega-projects pass feasibility on optimistic assumptions — then overrun by 50% or more.

climax.text: The Superconducting Super Collider passed feasibility but was cancelled at $2 billion — costs tripled.

punchline.text: Can we build it? Should we? Can we afford it? All three must be yes.

quiz.question: What does a feasibility study evaluate before a project begins?
options: Only the architectural aesthetics and design appeal
Technical, financial, environmental, and legal viability of the project
The number of workers available in the local labor market
